title: 7.18.2 Sub-build: A flag and a count inside an object
description: A Knight keeps a guarding flag, cleared by the next hit, which halves that hit with floor(n / 2), and a potions count that heals with min(hp + 12, maxHp) until it runs out.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The top says `hp 30/30   potions 2`. Press 1 a few times: each press takes a hit of 6. Keys 2 and 3 do nothing yet.

steps.title: Guard
steps.instructions: Inside the class, below `takeHit`, write `guard() { this.guarding = true; }`. At the top of `takeHit`, before the line that takes the hp: `if (this.guarding) n = floor(n / 2);` and then `this.guarding = false;`. In `draw()`, below the line for key 1: `if (kb.presses('2')) { k.guard(); note = 'Guarding'; }`. Run: press 2 and the top says GUARDING; press 1 and it takes only 3, and the next press of 1 takes 6 again.
hints: Halve first, while the flag is still on, then turn it off.
`floor(6 / 2)` is 3. Try a hit of 7 in the key-1 line: half of 7, rounded down, is 3.

steps.title: Drink a potion
steps.instructions: Below `guard()`, write `heal()` from the reading: if `this.potions === 0`, `return 0;`. Otherwise `this.potions -= 1;`, `const before = this.hp;`, `this.hp = min(this.hp + 12, this.maxHp);` and `return this.hp - before;`. In `draw()`: `if (kb.presses('3')) note = 'Potion: +' + k.heal();`. Run: take a few hits, then press 3 twice. A third press gives +0, because the potions are gone.
hints: At 30 out of 30, a potion gives +0: `min` never lets hp go above `maxHp`.
`heal` returns how much it really gave, so the note can say it.

requirements.title: Guard halves the next hit
requirements.description: While the flag is on, takeHit halves the hit (rounded down) and then turns the flag off; guard turns it on. Help: 7.18.1 (Reading: Three actions, a flag and a count)

requirements.title: A potion heals, capped, and uses one up
requirements.description: heal gives hp back but never above maxHp, takes one potion off the count, and does nothing when none are left. Help: 7.18.1 (Reading: Three actions, a flag and a count)
requirements.hint: if (this.potions === 0) return 0;  this.potions -= 1;  this.hp = min(this.hp + 12, this.maxHp);

requirements.title: 2 guards and 3 drinks
requirements.description: Key 2 calls the guard and key 3 the potion. Help: 7.18.1 (Reading: Three actions, a flag and a count)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: A flag and a count inside an object". The task: give the Knight guard(), which turns this.guarding on, make takeHit halve the hit with floor(n / 2) while guarding and then turn the flag off, and write heal(), which returns 0 with no potions left and otherwise uses one up and gives up to 12 hp back with min(this.hp + 12, this.maxHp), returning the hp gained; key 2 guards and key 3 drinks. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries, nested ifs, switch statements and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.

rubric.title: Guard
rubric.description: The next hit is halved, then the guard ends.

rubric.title: Potion
rubric.description: Heals up to max and uses one up.
